parameters.description:
`pushy-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushy` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Pushy URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `apikey_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's pushy apikey).
parameters.summary: Relay a push notification through your own Pushy account by posting a native Pushy payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's pushy apikey
